By Eric Song Posted : Sep 17, 2026 6:10pm UTC 0 comments Add IGN on Google Grand Theft Auto 6 is out in November and is shaping up to be the biggest game release of 2026, but there aren't very many physical collectibles announced. For example, there aren't any themed consoles ( like there was for Wolverine ), there's no collector's edition outside of an album , and in fact even the "physical" edition of the game will just be a code in a box. However, one tangible limited edition piece of hardware you can acquire is the DualSense controller. Walmart is currently offering preorders for the Grand Theft Auto Limited Edition PlayStation DualSense wireless gaming controller in white for $84.88 with free shipping. It's constantly going in and out of stock, although as of this article's publication it's available. Better yet, you can get an extra $10 on top by applying coupon code " SAVE3X ", dropping the price to $74.88. Your mileage may vary (it might not work for you) but we've confirmed that it is working for a lot of people. Here are the coupon code's official details: Valid on your first three online pickup or delivery orders Only for new customers (although it actually works for many returning customers) Minimum order of $35. Preorder the GTA VI Limited Edition DualSense Controller and potentially get $10 off with code "SAVE3X" Grand Theft Auto VI Limited Edition PlayStation 5 DualSense Wireless Controller 0 $84.88 save 12% $74.88 at Walmart Use code ' SAVE3X ' According to Sony , the limited edition controller “embodies Vice City at daybreak, from its white sands and pastel skies to all its laid-back glamour.” It features a two-tone white and iridescent purple/blue colorway, inset palm tree decorations, and a prominent GTA VI logo on the touch interface. It all looks pretty slick. The DualSense is modeled after the tried and true design and layout of previous PlayStation controllers, but it also packs in modern features such as haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, a built-in microphone and speaker, integrated touchpad, internal gyroscope and accelerometer for motion sensing, and USB Type-C charging. This controller can also be connected to a PC in two ways: tethered with a USB Type-C cable or over Bluetooth wireless. The Dualsense is often regarded as the best PS5 controller under $100 but it also makes for an excellent PC controller , especially since PC game clients like Steam support the DualSense's haptic feedback and adaptive triggers. Grand Theft Auto 6 will be the biggest game release of 2026 GTA 6 has a confirmed release date of November 19, and I'm pretty convinced that no other game will be played on PlayStation or Xbox consoles in the days following. Just recently there has been a flood of new content for the game from our own exclusive interviews, Gamescom 2026 , and Netflix's exclusive extended look . This game will be the biggest release of 2026 and it just might be worth getting a PlayStation 5 for just one game if that game happens to be Grand Theft Auto 6.
